title: ICAN Alpha 50 II Disc carbon road wheelset
notes: Official direct-store page: 50 mm depth, 23 mm inner and 28 mm outer width, clincher tubeless ready, ICAN D21 hub with 6 pawls and 72 engagement points, NBK steel or S&S ceramic bearings, Pillar SA1423 spokes 24/24, Center Lock, 12x100/12x142 mm, 1,459 ±20 g pair (front 671 g, rear 788 g), 110 kg rider weight limit and 2-year guarantee. Steel-bearing variants are US$490 on sale (compare-at US$545-565); ceramic variants are US$520. The page gives 700x25-32 mm recommended tires in its summary but 700x25-42 mm in the specification table, and publishes no bead type or maximum tire pressure.
